Chrome Music Lab — original Spectrogram

Packaged with compatibility changes by Motion Atlas, 2026-11-18.
Original project: https://github.com/googlecreativelab/chrome-music-lab
Pinned commit: e54bb414908da2b6286a6ad6431a5fcf8b68dc3f
Original work: Copyright 2016 Google Inc. All Rights Reserved.
Licensed under Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE and licenses/APACHE-2.0.txt.
This is not an official Google product. No endorsement is implied.

The upstream repository includes the sample MP3s, icon SVGs, gesture sprite,
renderer and shaders. No separate asset exception was found in that source.
These assets are retained unchanged; the icon font is regenerated from its SVGs.

Separately licensed runtime components follow. The original header text is
retained below and in editable source. Build tools are not shipped as runtime.
